changes.title: Party over look
items: When the last soundsystem falls the party is over: the dancefloor switches off tile by tile and the party lights go out in a ripple from home across the map, leaving the moonlit forest
Sleeping animals near you show little 😴 bubbles

changes.title: Party over
items: When the last soundsystem falls, the party's over: no game-over screen, an afterparty. The waves stop, nothing fights, and every animal strolls home and falls asleep, even the ones that ran off. Wander the sleeping forest as long as you like

changes.title: Afterparty sound
items: When the party's over the music winds down like a record stopping, and each area has its own quiet night: wind in the pines, frogs in the bogs, owls and crickets in the woods, the sea at home
Sleeping animals snore softly near you
